The '''[[1921 in association football|1921]]–[[1922 in association football|22]] season''' was the 30th season of [[The Football League]].

This year the Third Division was divided into North and South sections.  Third Division South continued the single new Third Division of the previous season. Two new clubs were placed in Third Division South, while 18 of 20 newcomers were placed in Third Division North, as the number of Football League clubs increased from 66 to 86.

==Final league tables==
The tables and results below are reproduced here in the exact form that they can be found at [https://www.rsssf.org/engpaul/FLA/1921-22.html The Rec.Sport.Soccer Statistics Foundation] website<ref name="rsssf">{{cite web |url=https://www.rsssf.org/engpaul/FLA/1921-22.html |title=England 1921-22 |publisher=Rec.Sport.Soccer Statistics Foundation|access-date=2010-02-24}}</ref> and in ''Rothmans Book of Football League Records 1888–89 to 1978–79'',<ref name="Rothmans">Ian Laschke: ''Rothmans Book of Football League Records 1888–89 to 1978–79''. Macdonald and Jane’s, London & Sydney, 1980.</ref> with home and away statistics separated.

==Third Division North==
The 20 teams were sourced from:
*1 relegated from the [[1920–21_Football_League#Second_Division|Football League Second Division]]: [[Stockport County]]
*1 transferred from the [[1920–21_Football_League#Third Division|original Third Division (South)]]: [[Grimsby Town]]
*6 from the [[Central League (England)|Central League]]: [[Stalybridge Celtic]], [[Nelson F.C.|Nelson]], [[Crewe Alexandra]], [[Southport F.C.|Southport]], [[Tranmere Rovers]], [[Rochdale A.F.C.|Rochdale]]
*4 from the [[North Eastern League]]: [[Ashington A.F.C.|Ashington]], [[Durham City A.F.C.|Durham City]], [[Darlington F.C.|Darlington]], [[Hartlepools United]]
*3 from the [[Lancashire Combination]]: [[Accrington Stanley]], [[Barrow A.F.C.|Barrow]], [[Wigan Borough F.C.|Wigan Borough]]
*2 from the [[West Midlands (Regional) League|Birmingham & District League]]: [[Walsall_F.C.|Walsall]], [[Wrexham A.F.C.|Wrexham]]
*3 from the [[Midland Football League (1889)|Midland Football League]]: [[Chesterfield F.C.|Chesterfield]], [[Lincoln City F.C.|Lincoln City]], [[Halifax Town A.F.C.|Halifax Town]]
